==Events==

==Births==
*[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]],<ref name="BirthDate">According to ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'', [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] was sixty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old during the events of ''[[Star Wars: Prelude to Rebellion]]'' and {{Film|I}}, dated to [[33 BBY/Legends|33]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], respectively, by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, Mundi's birth must have occurred sixty years before 33 BBY, in 93 BBY.</ref> on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]<ref name="E1IG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
